review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that the news media - have an excessive amount of influence over modern life, and this is phenomenon represents a negative trend. While I agree news media outlets exert an unprecedented level of sway over the public, I disagree that the news that is entirely a negative development, as its societal benefits are equally significant.

On the one hand, it is undeniable that the news media have come to dominate daily routines. Owing the widespread access to the smartphones and the Internet, the individuals can now follow current events instantaneously, regardless of time or location. Consequently, consuming news has seamlessly integrated into people’s everyday lives. Furthermore, driven by intense competition within the media industry, news agencies prioritize sensational breaking content. By employing dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, news outlets amplify the impact of their reporting, effectively shaping public opinion and steering collective focus.

On the other hand, although this powerful influence can bring clear drawbacks, it also serves an indispensable purpose. On negative note, continuous exposure to a stream of distressing and exaggerated news can overwhelm individuals, causing unnecessary anxiety and feelings of helplessness, even in situations that do not affect them directly. However, news coverage plays a vital role in alerting the public about pressing social issues, such as rising crime rates, impending natural disasters, or political corruption. Being regularly updated allow citizens to remain well-informed, better prepared for potential threats, and equipped to manage risks in an increasingly complex world.

In conclusion, while the news media undoubtedly hold immense sway over public consciousness and can occasionally induce stress, I do not consider this to be a purely negative shift. When consumed critically, the informative power of news remains essential for individual safety and social stability.
